screens.caption: Joining: scan the QR code, type a name
Add your face: a selfie or a doodle
The lobby: a QR code to join, seats for up to 8, bots to fill in
The VIP's phone runs the lobby
Accessibility settings: motion, CRT filter, text size, colour-blind shapes…
Every game opens with a slammed-in command and the rules
…while each phone shows your role, and READY
Loser picks: last place chooses the next game from three
Results: rows slide into the standings; lead changes get called out
Knocked out? Drop goo on the living and send emoji
The VIP can pause, skip a game or end the night
The final: a podium and awards for everyone
…and a rematch button for the VIP

games.title: Flap Frenzy
games.blurb: Flap through the pillars. Last blob flying wins.
games.controls: Tap FLAP on your phone

games.title: Sling Siege
games.blurb: Launch yourself at the enemy fort. Pop their kings!
games.controls: Drag back on your phone, release to launch

games.title: Chomp Chase
games.blurb: One chomper eats dots. Everyone else hunts it down.
games.controls: Swipe or use the d-pad

games.title: Sniper Plaza
games.blurb: Hide in the crowd and steal the loot. One sniper is watching.
games.controls: Runners: stick + BLEND. Sniper: drag to aim, FIRE

games.title: Sniper Blackout
games.blurb: Lights out. The sniper only sees through the scope. Use cover, watch your map.
games.controls: Runners: stick + mini-map. Sniper: drag to aim, FIRE

games.title: Infection
games.blurb: One blob is infected. Every touch spreads it. Last clean blob wins.
games.controls: Stick to move, DASH to escape (or pounce)

games.title: Kaiju
games.blurb: One giant blob wrecks the city. Everyone else charges the cannons.
games.controls: Kaiju: stick + STOMP. City: stick + DASH, stand on cannon pads

games.title: Blob Soccer
games.blurb: Two teams, one ball. First to 3 goals wins.
games.controls: Stick to run, KICK near the ball

games.title: Sumo Ring
games.blurb: Shove everyone off the shrinking ring. Last blob standing wins.
games.controls: Stick to move, BUMP to shove

games.title: Bumper Blobs
games.blurb: Bumper cars in a spiked pen. Knock them into the spikes.
games.controls: Stick to drive, BOOST to ram

games.title: Coin Rush
games.blurb: Coins rain down. Grab the most. Dodge the spike rollers.
games.controls: Stick to run, DASH to barge (they drop a coin)

games.title: Hot Potato
games.blurb: Bump someone to hand them the bomb. Don't be holding it when it pops.
games.controls: Stick to run, DASH to tag someone

games.title: Paint the Town
games.blurb: Roll around to paint the floor. Most ground covered wins.
games.controls: Stick to roll, SPLAT for a paint burst

games.title: Capture the Crown
games.blurb: Keep the crown on your team's head. Bump it off theirs.
games.controls: Stick to run, DASH to knock the crown loose

games.title: Jelly Dodgeball
games.blurb: Stay on your side. Grab a ball, throw it, knock them out.
games.controls: Stick to move and aim, THROW when holding a ball

games.title: Snake Pit
games.blurb: Grow your tail, cut them off. Don't bonk a tail.
games.controls: Stick to steer, tap BOOST for a burst (costs tail)

games.title: Tug of Jelly
games.blurb: Mash to pull the other team into the goo. Tap hard on HEAVE!
games.controls: Mash PULL. Taps during HEAVE! count triple

games.title: Relay Race
games.blurb: Take turns running the obstacle lane. Pass the baton, beat the other team.
games.controls: Stick to run, JUMP over hurdles

games.title: Tower Stack
games.blurb: Take turns dropping slabs. Overhang gets sliced off. Tallest tower wins.
games.controls: Tap DROP when it's your turn

games.title: Bomb Squad
games.blurb: One of you holds the bomb, the rest hold the manual. Talk it through!
games.controls: Defuser: wires, keypad, button on your phone · Everyone else: read your manual pages

games.title: Tilt Maze
games.blurb: Tilt your phone to roll through the maze. Mind the holes.
games.controls: Tilt the phone (or use the stick)

games.title: Draw Duel
games.blurb: Everyone draws the same prompt. Vote for the best one (not your own).
games.controls: Draw on your phone, then vote

games.title: Haunted House
games.blurb: One invisible ghost. Everyone else has a flashlight. Light it up before it spooks you.
games.controls: Hunters: stick (your beam points where you walk). Ghost: stick + VANISH, map on your phone

games.title: Whack-a-Blob
games.blurb: Moles pop up for gems. The hammer tries to bonk them.
games.controls: Moles: tap a hole to pop up, DUCK to hide. Hammer: tap holes to whack

games.title: Kraken
games.blurb: One raft, many rowers who must agree. One kraken who wants it sunk.
games.controls: Rowers: stick (the raft goes where you all point). Kraken: stick to aim, SLAM

games.title: Tank vs Swarm
games.blurb: Two players drive and gun one tank. Everyone else swarms it.
games.controls: Driver: stick + SHAKE. Gunner: stick aims + FIRE. Swarm: stick + DASH, latch on to gnaw

games.title: King of the Hill Giant
games.blurb: Hold the hill and you grow into a slow giant. Everyone else: topple them!
games.controls: Stick to move, SHOVE to charge

games.title: Blind Pilot
games.blurb: The TV is dark. Your pilot drives; the navigators see the track on their phones.
games.controls: Pilot: stick to steer. Navigators: read the map, shout directions!

games.title: Greed Doors
games.blurb: Pick a door in secret. Share the prize with whoever else picked it. One door is a bomb.
games.controls: Tap a door on your phone

modes.title: Board: Neon City
modes.blurb: Mario Party-style: roll, take forks, buy stars and items, duel, and play a minigame after every turn.

modes.title: Board: Slime Sewers
modes.blurb: Mario Party-style: roll, take forks, buy stars and items, duel, and play a minigame after every turn.

modes.title: Board: Volcano Island
modes.blurb: Mario Party-style: roll, take forks, buy stars and items, duel, and play a minigame after every turn.

modes.title: Microgame Gauntlet
modes.blurb: WarioWare-style: 20 microgames of a few seconds each, three lives, speeding up, with boss stages.
